Extra Ordinary
Ministry of Home Affairs
CSL
CSL
The President, having recovered from illness, will resume his duties on Wednesday, the 20th December, 1961.
Extra Ordinary
Ministry of Home Affairs
CSL
CSL

The President being unable to discharge his functions owing to illness, the Vice-President will, in pursuance of clause (2)of article 65 of the Constitution of India, discharge the functions of the President until the date on which the President resumes his duties.
